desc: Ideation: coordinate grouping + binary search + DSU-skip for O((N+M)α(N)) distinct-house counting
Write full solution: parse input via sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
Build rows[y] -> sorted x list and cols[x] -> sorted y list, each with parallel house-index array and DSU parent array
Simulate moves: update position, bisect range, DSU-walk to collect and mark visited houses

Output final X, Y, visited count; verified against sample 1 (2 3 2) and sample 2 (3000000000 0 0); edge cases (empty groups, large coordinates, repeated passes) handled by DSU removal and unbounded Python ints
